summary: This directory provides the infrastructure for rendering UI components using the Shadcn library. It acts as a bridge between abstract component requirements and specific Shadcn implementation details, ensuring consistent component display through a centralized mapping mechanism.
responsibilities: Map abstract UI component definitions to concrete Shadcn implementations
Facilitate the rendering of standardized UI elements
Expose unified access to Shadcn-based rendering logic
relationships: The component mapping links generic UI types to specific Shadcn component implementations.
The renderer interface consumes the component mapping to dynamically resolve and display UI elements.
designDecisions: Utilizes a registry or mapping pattern to decouple UI component definitions from library-specific implementations
Centralizes renderer exports to provide a consistent interface for the application
